character: A small wiry man of thirty-five, notched ears, a jeweller's loupe screwed into one eye, a quick toothy grin.
wardrobe: A long captain's coat cut down to his size with the braid picked off, three tool belts, a small chisel on a cord round his neck.

full.framing: Full body portrait, front view. Standing in a narrow shop crammed floor to ceiling with ropes, lanterns and crates, holding up a brass lantern.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame, facing the viewer.

scene.framing: Behind a counter in a cramped hold full of shelves, painted ship names on boards above each shelf, scraping initials off a pewter cup with a chisel.
